newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late olein stable, CPO lower.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late olein stable, CPO lower.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Tuesday but crude palm oil was lower, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,415-20 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but trades were also heard at 1,410 rupiah.

The traders said crude palm oil was done at 1,027.50 rupiah/kg, excluding tax and transportation costs, at a 750 tonne tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan. The previous tender price was 1,083 rupiah/kg.
"I believe the tender price was lower because the collection point is quite a distance from the port," one trader said.
The trader said he did not expect the tender price to have an impact on olein prices.

Another trader said the lower price could be due to the higher export tax on crude palm oil in December. "The increase in the export tax is expected to affect crude palm oil exports, and this is why the tender price was lower."

The tax on crude palm oil was raised to $44.72/tonne from $28.00 in November. That on RBD palm olein was raised to $41.30/tonne from $18.75 in November. The tax on RBD palm oil was raised to $33.04/tonne in December from $19.20. The tax on crude olein was raised to $44.80/tonne from $22.50.

Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Ben Aicha will leave the port on Wednesday for Rotterdam with 15,000 tonnes of palm kernel oil. The MT Cakra-l will leave also on Wednesday for Tanjung Priok with 2,000 tonnes of olein.
The KM Permaisuri will leave on Wednesday for Tanjung Priok with 2,200 tonnes of olein.
